# Kashi Vadhyar

> Hindu rites and spiritual yatras across Kashi (Varanasi), Gaya and Prayagraj, guided by hereditary Tamil Kshetra Purohit Mr. Venu Gopal Shastrigal, whose family has served pilgrims for over a century.

Kashi Vadhyar arranges Vedic rituals and complete pilgrimage packages for Tamil-speaking families: Pind Daan, Shradh, Pitra Dosh Nivaran, Asthi Visarjan, Pitru Tarpan and special poojas (Rudrabhishek, Navagraha Shanti, Mangal Dosh Nivaran) performed at the sacred ghats and temples of Kashi, Gaya and Prayag. Yatra packages of 5, 7 and 11 days include stay, transport and hereditary Vadhyar guidance at each kshetra. The site is bilingual — English and Tamil (தமிழ்).

## Pages

- / — Home: video hero of the Ganga Aarti, ritual services, packages, HD Kashi video gallery, testimonials, upcoming festival dates
- /about-us — The century-old tradition of Tamil Kshetra Purohit Mr. Venu Gopal Shastrigal and the services offered
- /poojas — Details of each ritual: Pind Daan, Shradh, Pitra Dosh Nivaran, Asthi Visarjan, Pitru Tarpan, Special Poojas
- /packages — 5, 7 and 11 day Kashi–Gaya–Prayag yatra packages
- /packages/5-day-package, /packages/7-day-package, /packages/11-day-package — day-by-day itineraries
- /events — Festival ritual bookings with dates derived from a built-in panchangam dataset (Mahalaya Paksha, Vinayaka Chaturthi, Gokulashtami, Navratri, Maha Shivaratri)
- /gallery — Photo gallery and HD videos of Kashi, the ghats, Ganga Aarti and real rituals
- /contact-us — WhatsApp enquiry form, muhurat (auspicious day) calendar, address and phone numbers
